title: C/Zephyr: state dump on assertion/panic
description: When a C node hits __ASSERT or fatal error, only file:line is logged — no surrounding state. Fix: register a fatal error handler that dumps key scalars before halt: TX queue depth, replay counter, routing table size, TDMA slot, modem state, last RX packet size/sender. Use Zephyr coredump subsystem (CONFIG_DEBUG_COREDUMP) for full post-mortem on native_sim, compact LOG_ERR summary for embedded. Even 5-6 key values make most assertion failures diagnosable from logs alone.
